clarification: Casey did not originate a standing preference for safe, small, minimal, MVP-first, smallest-slice, or narrow-by-default engineering. Later acceptance of assistant-proposed minimization may reflect reliance on assistant expertise and must not be treated as proof of original user intent.
suspect_minimization_terms: bounded local surface as final target
controlling_rule: Only USER_ORIGINATED constraints may be treated as evidence that Casey wanted the destination reduced. ASSISTANT_PROPOSED_USER_ACCEPTED is not sufficient because acceptance may reflect trust in assistant engineering judgment rather than independent user preference.
recovery_rule: When a later minimization rule conflicts with earlier or repeated user-authored ambition, reconstruct chronology and preserve the strongest directly user-authored objective unless Casey later independently and explicitly replaced it.
